description: This file is a shell library intended for testing credential handling in Git. It defines functions to check credentials, test credential helpers, and simulate various credential scenarios. The code includes comprehensive testing routines for credential storage, retrieval, overwriting, and handling edge cases like long headers and timeouts.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Reads credential input, executes 'git credential', and compares expected outputs for testing credential helpers.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin until '--' is encountered, returns the lines.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Clears residual credential data to ensure clean test environment.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects credentials for a given protocol, host, and username via 'git credential reject'.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs comprehensive tests on a specified credential helper, covering storage, retrieval, overwriting, and special cases.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving password expiry times.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests handling of authtype capabilities and credentials.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates an 'askpass' script that outputs a token based on input arguments.
